project_type: IoT hardware project with Python tooling, ESPHome firmware, 3D models, and MkDocs documentation
language: Python 3.11+ (minimum), YAML (workflows, ESPHome configs), OpenSCAD (3D models)
build_system: uv for Python dependency management (migrated from pip-tools in PR #72), pre-commit for linting, ESPHome for firmware compilation
test_framework: pytest with pytest-mock, test files in tests/ and .github/scripts/ directories
build_command: N/A - no single build command, workflows validate various aspects independently
verification_instructions: Validate YAML syntax of all workflow files using yamllint or a YAML parser. Ensure action version references are valid semver tags.
snapshot_or_generated_files: 3d_models/*.stl files are generated by the stl-generation workflow but not relevant to this task
environment_constraints: GitHub Actions workflows are YAML files - validation is syntactic only (no runtime execution possible in sandbox). Cannot test workflows end-to-end.
contribution_requirements: Project uses Renovate for dependency updates. Action versions should use semver tags (not commit SHAs, not digests). The renovate.json has pinDigests: false.
key_patterns: Workflows use astral-sh/setup-uv then actions/setup-python then uv pip install --system. Python version is 3.13 in most workflows. deploy-docs.yml is outdated (uses pip install directly, older action versions). All workflows use --- YAML document start marker.
directory_structure: .github/workflows/ contains 7 workflow files. .github/scripts/ contains Python build/BOM tooling. docs/ has MkDocs documentation. esphome/ has firmware configs. 3d_models/ has SCAD/STL files.
